items.title: Config-resolved material-code policy service threaded via a hash-bound snapshot
items.context: Add resolveMaterialCodePolicy(projectRoot) and a HEAD+materialHash-bound classification snapshot passed into all three consumers: review-assurance floor, repro classification (collectMaterialCodeFiles gains the snapshot; fixes the dropped-projectRoot call), and the ProofStory diagnostic input. Pure evaluators stay pure.
items.userSees: An identical bug story flips required=true across floor + repro + ProofStory triggers, all driven by one classification snapshot; project materialCode config reaches all three consumers.

items.title: Eight-step precedence chain with non-excludable cross-ecosystem manifests and strict resolver
items.context: Replace the flat whitelist with the 8-step precedence chain: level-1 immutable runtime/build-config names (JS set + go.mod/Cargo.toml/pyproject.toml/pom.xml/gradle/etc.) that no config key can exclude, enforced by config-resolve rejection AND a filesystem-aware transition preflight; storyDir-aware metadata exclusion; excludePaths; docs; removeExtensions; code-extension-gated path prefixes with shebang/exec-bit rule for extensionless scripts; resolved extension set; default non-material. Strict config resolver: normalized extensions, segment-aware paths, fail-closed on malformed.
items.userSees: go.mod at repo root classifies material with no extension/prefix; excludePaths naming a manifest is rejected; src/design.pptx stays non-material; src-old/ does not match src/.

items.title: Degradation diagnostics produced by buildScopeDiffPack for unsupported languages
items.context: Emit normalized semantic_analysis_unavailable diagnostics from parseUnifiedDiff/buildScopeDiffPack (scope-diff-pack.ts:265-315) and from the no-scope-contract path; mutating callers write the deduped, union-typed process event. Semantic anchors stay TS/JS-only (no new parsers).
items.userSees: A no-contract story with a material .go file surfaces exactly one semantic_analysis_unavailable degradation event.
